objective: Establish a repository where GitHub Issues drive project-local execution contracts.
successCriteria: A fresh session can recover an execution contract from its Issue and parent Goal.
No user-level agent configuration is required.

allowed: Write project-local files and authorized GitHub records in @@AGX_TARGET_SLUG@@.
forbidden: Modify user-level agent configuration or another repository.

deliverables: Project-local contract schemas and validation tooling.
stopConditions: A required change exceeds the permissions recorded by the Goal.
ownerAction: The repository maintainer reviews the next bounded Execution Contract.
